_comment: RETIREMENT NOTICE for the pre-1.1 (old-schema) plugin catalog. Academic Studio 1.1+ reads plugins.json instead; only v1.0-and-earlier apps still fetch THIS file. Rather than serve them stale/buggy plugin tarballs, this returns a single entry whose label tells them to update to 1.1. v1.0 surfaces it two ways: as a row in Run Setup's plugin list (with the 'Learn more' link from infoUrl), and — because v1.0 still runs the startup 'new plugin available' notification — as a launch-time popup. No skill/pip, so installing it is a harmless no-op. Do not add real plugins here; the plugin catalog is plugins.json.

packages.label: Update to Academic Studio 1.1 — plugins have moved to a new system and this list is retired. Click 'Learn more' to download 1.1, then reinstall your plugins from Run Setup.
